name: Dream Machine nightly self-improvement
cadence: nightly (cron 37 2 * * *, see dream.config.json) -- the only genuinely repeated, gated job already running in this repo; not weekly

reviewer.name: repository owner
reviewer.mechanism: opens a draft PR only; autoMerge is false in dream.config.json, so a human always merges or closes

spending_limit.description: one Claude Code cloud session per night; candidate diff capped at 300 lines; exactly one baseline pass and one evaluation pass of `make test`; no retries -- an untestable night ends INCONCLUSIVE with a written reason, not a second attempt

inputs: docs/dream-cycle/LEDGER.md (every prior night's finding and verdict)
the current main branch source and tests
outputs: exactly one new row appended to docs/dream-cycle/LEDGER.md
a GitHub issue describing the night's finding
a draft PR on a dream/ branch, only when the verdict is ACCEPT

gates.name: baseline-score
requires: `make test` run against the OLD code, result recorded

gates.name: candidate-change
requires: no test weakened, skipped, or deleted

gates.name: evaluation-score
requires: `make test` run against the NEW code, same suite as the baseline

gates.name: adversarial-critique
requires: a written check for cheating or test-weakening in the candidate

gates.name: witness-hash
requires: a hash tying the written report to the exact commit evaluated

gates.name: final-review
requires: exactly one verdict of ACCEPT, REJECT, or INCONCLUSIVE
a draft PR opened only on ACCEPT, labeled dream-cycle
the ledger row appended and re-validated by dream_check.validate_ledger
gates.blocks: publish (merge) -- a human decides, this workflow never merges itself
